latin_text: [HARVESTER: from Allen critical translation; source location: Garin edition, Commento 1.6, pp. 467-468]
english_translation: But Mind, identified hypostatically with Saturn, nonetheless has three functions – a Saturnian contemplation of things higher than itself (but such can only be God); a Saturnian contemplation 'that stays within itself,' that is, a contemplation of itself as the first, most perfect creature; and a Jovian downward, providential regarding of the universe it creates.
exegesis: [PLACEHOLDER: Pico describes the angelic Mind through the mythological apparatus of Saturn and Jupiter, giving the angelic intellect three simultaneous functions: upward contemplation of God, self-regarding contemplation of its own perfection, and downward creative providential activity. This trinitarian structure echoes both Pseudo-Dionysius and Proclus. SYNTHESIZER to develop implications for angelic activity.]
kabbalistic_elements: The three functions correspond to the triadic structure found in Kabbalistic emanation (knowledge ascending, self-awareness reflecting, creative influence descending). Parallels the Supernal Triad (Keter/Chokmah/Binah).

other_texts: Ficino's Platonic Theology on triadic emanation

notes: HARVESTER context: Describes angelic Mind's three functions through Saturn/Jupiter mythology. Source: Allen, p. 6178-6182; Garin edition, Commento 1.6, pp. 467-468. Kabbalistic density: MODERATE-HIGH (triadic emanation parallels).
